Description: The quote denom of the pool.
Available quote balance in the pool (human-readable notional units).
Raw unrealised PnL across all positions in the pool.
Effective unrealised PnL after applying positive uPnL haircut.
Equity used for order admission checks (quote_balance + position_margin + uPnL_eff - fees_buffer).
Equity used for liquidation checks (uses raw uPnL, not haircutted).
Sum of initial margin requirements for existing positions only.
Sum of maintenance margin requirements for existing positions.
Initial margin using worst-case net exposure (q + B, q - S) across all markets.
Sum of entry losses for all open orders.
Sum of fee reserves for all open orders.
Order Lock Requirement = IM_with_orders + entry_loss + fee_reserve. Orders may be cancelled if equity_admission < order_lock_requirement.
The positive uPnL haircut rate applied (e.g., 0.5 = 50%).

Health factor = equity_liquidation / maintenance_margin_total. When < 1, the account is liquidatable. When < 1.5, the account is in a warning state. Empty if maintenance_margin_total is zero (no positions).

Ratcheted maintenance margin total: max(maintenance at current mark, maintenance at entry notional) summed across positions. This is the maintenance floor used in the cash-floor and withdrawable formulas, and is distinct from maintenance_margin_total. It is NOT derivable from the other response fields, so off-chain monitors need it to reconstruct the chain's admission / withdrawal predicates.
Cross-margin utilisation ratio applied to the cash floor (0 is the emergency halt on new risk-increasing actions). A module param, not recoverable from any other response field.

Position-side Order Lock Requirement bucket embedded in order_lock_requirement. This is the sum of max(position.Margin, 0), not the signed position_margin_total. It is exposed because negative-funded or mixed-sign position margins make the OLR split impossible to reconstruct from position_margin_total.

Non-position Order Lock Requirement bucket used by the cash-floor formula. This is not generally max(order_lock_requirement - position_margin_total, 0) because position_margin_total is signed while the position-side OLR bucket floors each position margin at zero. Together with ratcheted_maintenance_margin_total, cross_margin_util_ratio, and the existing equity fields, monitors can derive fees_buffer (= quote_balance + position_margin_total + unrealized_pnl_effective - equity_admission), cash_floor_available, admission_available (= equity_admission - order_lock_requirement), available_for_new (= min(cash_floor_available, admission_available)), and withdrawable.
